title: Citizen
subtitle: 「公民／市民／國民／社區成員」，這個詞最重要的是先分清法律國籍和一般公共語境。
description: 「公民／市民／國民／社區成員」，這個詞最重要的是先分清法律國籍和一般公共語境。

words.example: The embassy assists nationals who lose their passports abroad.
words.exampleZh: 大使館協助在海外遺失護照的本國國民。

exercises.original: The embassy helps citizens who lose their passports abroad.
exercises.zh: 大使館協助在海外遺失護照的本國國民。
exercises.upgrade: The embassy helps nationals who lose their passports abroad.

options.explanation: embassy + passports + abroad 明確是國籍／領事保護語境，national 最貼切。
居住身份不能證明由該國大使館提供領事保護。
投票資格和護照支援不是同一分類。
移民可能不是該國國民。

exercises.original: Only citizens of the country may apply for this passport.
exercises.zh: 只有該國國民可以申請這本護照。
exercises.upgrade: Only nationals of the country may apply for this passport.

options.explanation: 永久居民也未必有資格申請該國護照。
passport eligibility 和 nationality 直接相關。
選區代表關係不等於護照資格。

exercises.original: The consulate issued emergency documents to stranded citizens.
exercises.zh: 領事館向滯留海外的本國國民發出緊急文件。
exercises.upgrade: The consulate issued emergency documents to stranded nationals.

options.explanation: 住在某地不等於由領事館服務。
consulate + emergency documents 是典型國籍語境。

words.example: Any member of the public may submit comments on the proposal.
words.exampleZh: 任何公眾人士都可以就建議提交意見。

exercises.original: Any citizen may submit a complaint about the service.
exercises.zh: 任何公眾人士都可以就服務提出投訴。
exercises.upgrade: Any member of the public may submit a complaint about the service.

options.explanation: 公共服務投訴通常對一般公眾開放，國籍不是核心。
會不必要地限制為本國國民。
只有在民意代表選區服務語境才合適。
使用公共服務的人未必是納稅人。

exercises.original: Citizens were invited to comment on the proposed park design.
exercises.zh: 市民獲邀就新公園設計提出意見。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the public were invited to comment on the proposed park design.

options.explanation: 也可，但若 consultation 對所有公眾開放，這會過度限制為當地居民。
comment on proposal 的公眾諮詢語境最自然。
未必只限有投票資格者。

exercises.original: The information desk is open to all citizens visiting the building.
exercises.zh: 資訊櫃檯向所有到訪大樓的公眾人士開放。
exercises.upgrade: The information desk is open to all members of the public visiting the building.

options.explanation: building access/service 的使用者是一般公眾。
外國訪客也可能使用資訊櫃檯。

words.example: Every member of the community was invited to the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 每名社區成員都獲邀參加會議。

exercises.original: Every citizen in the neighbourhood was invited to the clean-up day.
exercises.zh: 社區每名成員都獲邀參加清潔日。
exercises.upgrade: Every member of the community was invited to the clean-up day.

options.explanation: 國籍和 neighbourhood clean-up 無關。
社區活動的歸屬和參與最吻合。
未成年社區成員也可參加。
不一定每人都是納稅人。
活動不是選區代表服務。

exercises.original: The centre encourages citizens to volunteer locally.
exercises.zh: 中心鼓勵社區成員參與本地義工服務。
exercises.upgrade: The centre encourages members of the community to volunteer locally.

options.explanation: 太廣，沒有 local community 的直接焦點。
volunteer locally 是明確社區參與語境。
有些社區成員可能不是正式居民身份。

exercises.original: Citizens worked together to organise the neighbourhood festival.
exercises.zh: 社區成員合作籌辦鄰里節慶。
exercises.upgrade: Members of the community worked together to organise the neighbourhood festival.

options.explanation: neighbourhood festival 是典型社區共同參與。

words.example: Schools aim to prepare students to become responsible members of society.
words.exampleZh: 學校旨在培養學生成為負責任的社會成員。

exercises.original: Schools should help children become responsible citizens.
exercises.zh: 學校應幫助兒童成為負責任的社會成員。
exercises.upgrade: Schools should help children become responsible members of society.

options.explanation: responsible citizen 在公民教育語境強調社會角色和責任。
國籍不是這句教育目標的核心。
兒童當下未必有投票資格。

exercises.original: The programme teaches young people how to become active citizens.
exercises.zh: 計劃教年輕人如何成為積極參與社會的成員。
exercises.upgrade: The programme teaches young people how to become active members of society.

options.explanation: 能涵蓋義工、公共參與和社會責任。

exercises.original: A good citizen contributes positively to society.
exercises.zh: 良好的公民會以正面方式貢獻社會。
exercises.upgrade: A responsible member of society contributes positively to society.

options.explanation: 納稅只是眾多社會角色之一。
positive contribution 是社會責任語境。
國籍本身不等於正面貢獻。

words.example: Residents can apply for a parking permit online.
words.exampleZh: 居民可以在網上申請泊車許可證。

exercises.original: Citizens of the city can apply for a local parking permit.
exercises.zh: 城市居民可以申請本地泊車許可證。
exercises.upgrade: Residents of the city can apply for a local parking permit.

options.explanation: parking permit 通常以居住地為核心，而不是國籍。
本國國民住在其他城市也未必合資格。
投票資格未必是泊車證條件。

exercises.original: The survey asked citizens living in the district about bus services.
exercises.zh: 調查詢問區內居民對巴士服務的意見。
exercises.upgrade: The survey asked residents of the district about bus services.

options.explanation: 會排除未登記或未達投票年齡的居民。
living in the district 是直接定義。
若不是議員調查，代表關係不是核心。

exercises.original: City services are available to citizens who live locally.
exercises.zh: 城市服務供居住在本地的居民使用。
exercises.upgrade: City services are available to local residents.

options.explanation: who live locally 正好限定服務資格。
國籍不一定是地方服務條件。

words.example: Local residents raised concerns about traffic noise.
words.exampleZh: 當地居民對交通噪音表示關注。

exercises.original: Citizens living near the airport complained about noise.
exercises.zh: 住在機場附近的當地居民投訴噪音。
exercises.upgrade: Local residents living near the airport complained about noise.

options.explanation: near the airport + noise concern 是地方住址語境。
只有和民意代表互動時才突出。

exercises.original: The council consulted citizens before changing the road layout.
exercises.zh: 議會在改動道路設計前諮詢當地居民。
exercises.upgrade: The council consulted local residents before changing the road layout.

options.explanation: 也可，但道路改動通常最直接影響當地住戶，local residents 更精準。
council + road layout + local impact 是典型地方諮詢。

exercises.original: The proposal has strong support among citizens in the surrounding area.
exercises.zh: 建議得到周邊地區居民大力支持。
exercises.upgrade: The proposal has strong support among local residents in the surrounding area.

options.explanation: surrounding area 明確是地理居住關係。

words.example: The island has fewer than two thousand inhabitants.
words.exampleZh: 這個島的居民少於二千人。

exercises.original: The island has fewer than two thousand citizens.
exercises.zh: 這個島的居民少於二千人。
exercises.upgrade: The island has fewer than two thousand inhabitants.

options.explanation: 人口／地理描述中，inhabitants 是最自然的『居住者』。
島上居民未必都是同一國籍。

exercises.original: Most citizens of the village work in agriculture.
exercises.zh: 這條村大部分居民從事農業。
exercises.upgrade: Most inhabitants of the village work in agriculture.

options.explanation: 也自然，但本題目標是較描述性的 inhabitants。
village population 描述非常合適。

exercises.original: The region's citizens depend heavily on fishing.
exercises.zh: 該地區居民高度依賴漁業。
exercises.upgrade: The region's inhabitants depend heavily on fishing.

options.explanation: 也可，但 inhabitants 在地理描述中更書面。
region + livelihood 是典型人口描述。

words.meaning: 選區居民；選民／選區成員
words.example: The representative met constituents to discuss local transport problems.
words.exampleZh: 該民意代表與選區居民會面，討論本地交通問題。

exercises.original: The senator met citizens from her district to discuss transport.
exercises.zh: 參議員與選區居民會面討論交通。
exercises.upgrade: The senator met constituents from her district to discuss transport.

options.explanation: senator + her district 是直接代表關係。
雖然多數 constituents 也是居民，但失去『由她代表』的政治關係。

exercises.original: Citizens contacted their representative about the proposed closure.
exercises.zh: 選區居民就擬議關閉安排聯絡民意代表。
exercises.upgrade: Constituents contacted their representative about the proposed closure.

options.explanation: 太廣，不一定由該 representative 代表。
constituents 可包括部分未投票者。

exercises.original: The elected member holds weekly meetings for citizens in the constituency.
exercises.zh: 民選代表每週與選區居民會面。
exercises.upgrade: The elected member holds weekly meetings for constituents.

options.explanation: elected member + constituency 是標準搭配。

words.meaning: 選民群體成員；有投票資格者
words.example: The campaign is aimed at members of the electorate who have not yet voted.
words.exampleZh: 這項運動以尚未投票的合資格選民為對象。

exercises.original: The campaign targets citizens who are eligible to vote.
exercises.zh: 這項運動以有投票資格的選民為對象。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign targets members of the electorate.

options.explanation: eligible to vote 是直接定義。
非公民或未成年居民可能不能投票。
未達投票年齡者不包括。

exercises.original: Not every citizen is yet old enough to join the electorate.
exercises.zh: 並非每名公民都已達加入選民群體的年齡。
exercises.upgrade: Not every citizen is yet old enough to be a member of the electorate.

options.explanation: old enough + voting eligibility 直接相關。
可被代表而未必有投票資格。

exercises.original: The survey was limited to citizens registered to vote.
exercises.zh: 調查只限已登記投票的選民。
exercises.upgrade: The survey was limited to members of the electorate who were registered to vote.

options.explanation: registered to vote 是明確選民語境。

words.example: The evacuation plan prioritised civilians living near the border.
words.exampleZh: 疏散計劃優先處理居住在邊境附近的平民。

exercises.original: The evacuation plan protects citizens living near the conflict zone.
exercises.zh: 疏散計劃保護居住在衝突區附近的平民。
exercises.upgrade: The evacuation plan protects civilians living near the conflict zone.

options.explanation: conflict zone 下重點是非軍職平民身份。
會把保護對象誤限為某國國民。
只說居住，不突出軍民區分。

exercises.original: The military operation was designed to minimise harm to citizens.
exercises.zh: 軍事行動旨在盡量減少對平民的傷害。
exercises.upgrade: The military operation was designed to minimise harm to civilians.

options.explanation: 可以泛指普通人，但軍事語境的標準角色詞是 civilians。
military operation 與非軍人形成清楚對比。

exercises.original: Aid was delivered to citizens caught in the fighting.
exercises.zh: 援助送到受戰火影響的平民手中。
exercises.upgrade: Aid was delivered to civilians caught in the fighting.

options.explanation: 不必要地加入國籍限制。
caught in the fighting 的人道語境最自然。

words.example: The project must provide value for taxpayers.
words.exampleZh: 這個項目必須為納稅人提供物有所值的效益。

exercises.original: The project must offer value to citizens who fund public services through taxes.
exercises.zh: 項目必須為透過稅收資助公共服務的納稅人提供物有所值的效益。
exercises.upgrade: The project must offer value to taxpayers.

options.explanation: fund public services through taxes 是直接定義。
公民未必都有納稅責任。
居民身份不等於納稅身份。

exercises.original: The report asks whether citizens are getting good value for public spending.
exercises.zh: 報告詢問納稅人是否從公共開支獲得良好效益。
exercises.upgrade: The report asks whether taxpayers are getting good value for public spending.

options.explanation: value for public spending 常以 taxpayer perspective 表達。

exercises.original: The cost will eventually be borne by citizens through taxation.
exercises.zh: 成本最終會由納稅人透過稅收承擔。
exercises.upgrade: The cost will eventually be borne by taxpayers.

options.explanation: 並非所有居民承擔相同稅負。
through taxation 明確指出經濟角色。

words.example: Local community members helped design the new park.
words.exampleZh: 本地社區成員協助設計新公園。

exercises.original: Citizens helped choose the design for the new playground.
exercises.zh: 本地社區成員協助選擇新遊樂場設計。
exercises.upgrade: Local community members helped choose the design for the new playground.

options.explanation: playground + local participation 是典型社區參與。
未成年家庭成員也可能參與。

exercises.original: The project was designed with input from citizens in the neighbourhood.
exercises.zh: 項目在本地社區成員提供意見下設計。
exercises.upgrade: The project was designed with input from local community members.

options.explanation: 公共參與不應只限合資格選民。

exercises.original: Citizens volunteered to run the neighbourhood food bank.
exercises.zh: 本地社區成員自願協助營運鄰里食物銀行。
exercises.upgrade: Local community members volunteered to run the neighbourhood food bank.

options.explanation: 可能太窄，附近工作／參與社區的人也可能是 community member。
neighbourhood volunteering 是最直接的社區角色。

words.meaning: 一般市民；普通公眾人士
words.example: The information should be easy for an ordinary member of the public to understand.
words.exampleZh: 這些資料應讓一般市民容易理解。

exercises.original: The instructions should be clear enough for any ordinary citizen to understand.
exercises.zh: 指示應清楚得讓任何一般市民都能理解。
exercises.upgrade: The instructions should be clear enough for any ordinary member of the public to understand.

options.explanation: 與專家／內部人員相對的一般使用者語境最自然。
國籍不影響是否理解指示。

exercises.original: The website was tested with ordinary citizens rather than specialists.
exercises.zh: 網站以一般市民而非專家進行測試。
exercises.upgrade: The website was tested with ordinary members of the public rather than specialists.

options.explanation: rather than specialists 是直接對比線索。

exercises.original: Legal information should be accessible to ordinary citizens.
exercises.zh: 法律資訊應讓一般市民容易理解和取得。
exercises.upgrade: Legal information should be accessible to ordinary members of the public.

options.explanation: 法律資訊不是只給某選區居民。
accessible legal information 的對象是一般公眾。
外籍居民／訪客也可能需要法律資訊。

words.meaning: 公民社群成員；公共社群一分子
words.example: The programme encourages students to become active civic community members.
words.exampleZh: 計劃鼓勵學生成為積極參與公共生活的社群成員。

exercises.original: The course encourages students to become active citizens.
exercises.zh: 課程鼓勵學生成為積極參與公共生活的公民社群成員。
exercises.upgrade: The course encourages students to become active civic community members.

options.explanation: civic education + active participation 最吻合。

exercises.original: Volunteering can help young people see themselves as responsible citizens.
exercises.zh: 義工服務可幫助年輕人視自己為負責任的公民社群成員。
exercises.upgrade: Volunteering can help young people see themselves as responsible civic community members.

options.explanation: 青年未必都有投票資格，且 volunteering 超出選舉參與。
volunteering + responsibility 是典型公民社會語境。

exercises.original: The programme teaches what it means to be a citizen who contributes to public life.
exercises.zh: 計劃教授何謂積極參與公共生活的公民社群成員。
exercises.upgrade: The programme teaches what it means to be a civic community member who contributes to public life.

options.explanation: contributes to public life 是 civic role 的核心。

falseSynonyms.zh: 居民不等於公民 resident 只表示居住在某地；可以沒有該國國籍。反過來，公民也可以住在海外。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Residence and citizenship are separate legal concepts.

falseSynonyms.zh: 國民與 citizen 很接近但法律上未必完全相同 某些制度會把 national 和 citizen 作不同法律分類，因此在法律文件中應沿用原術語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Nationality and citizenship often overlap, but some legal systems distinguish them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 選民不等於所有 citizen 不是所有公民都有投票資格，例如未達投票年齡的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A voter is eligible to vote; a citizen may or may not be eligible.

falseSynonyms.zh: 納稅人不等於 citizen 非公民也可以在某地納稅，而部分公民可能沒有應課稅收入。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Tax status and citizenship are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 移民不等於 citizen immigrant 描述移居經歷／身份；移民可能已入籍，也可能仍不是公民。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An immigrant may or may not become a citizen.

falseSynonyms.zh: 難民不等於 citizen refugee 是受到國際／國內法律保護的身份，並不自動表示所在國公民。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Refugee status does not automatically confer citizenship.

falseSynonyms.zh: 平民不等於 citizen civilian 只表示不是軍職人員；可以是任何國籍。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Civilian is a military-status category, not a nationality category.

falseSynonyms.zh: 公眾人士不等於 citizen 遊客、外籍居民等也可屬公眾人士，因此此詞只在『一般市民』語境接近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A member of the public need not be a citizen of the country.
